publication_scope: Owner requested publication of the Android APK, app source, instructions and playmat preview in the GitHub repository. This record covers only the five exact inspected binary artifacts below, not other private website material or future changed versions.

assets.review_evidence: Generated by the verified Gradle 8.11.1 wrapper task. Independently inspected ZIP integrity and all 33 entry names; no unsafe paths, signing keys or local environment files. This is build-tool code, not a user data archive.

Its signing certificate matches the previously published version 0.1.1 APK, preserving signature compatibility for installation updates. All eight packaged web assets match reviewed public app source byte for byte and UTF-8 assets pass existing privacy patterns. Archive integrity and all 14 entry names were checked; no signing keystore or local toolchain is packaged.

Version 0.1.2 source archive independently inspected for integrity and all 44 entry names. Every member matches reviewed public app source byte for byte, and every UTF-8 member passes existing privacy patterns. Contains app source, regression tests, public card data, playmat artwork, license and sanitized instructions; excludes SDK/JDK caches, credentials, private website source links and signing material.

Version 0.1.2 Commander-interface preview independently viewed: public teaching decks and the public Ovika card illustrate the command zone and gold divider, without a private user deck list or personal identifiers. PNG dimensions are 390 by 2560 pixels. All chunk CRCs verify; only IHDR, IDAT and IEND chunks are present, with no EXIF, text, location or contact metadata.

Existing public-facing Compleated Loyalty playmat artwork reused in the app requested for publication. Independently inspected WebP structure: a VP8 image chunk only, with no EXIF or XMP metadata. No original private website source archive is included.
